navigation.latency_slow: Navigation tick takes %d ms at the median (about 110 ms is normal): screencap %d ms, image processing %d ms, localization %d ms, steering input %d ms, everything else %d ms. At this speed turns come too late, so the character tends to hit walls or fall into water. Try lowering the in-game graphics quality and resolution, closing heavy background programs, and checking whether GPU usage is too high. This notice does not interrupt the task.
navigation.sensitivity_corrected: Navigation turns consistently differ from the commanded angle: measured turns reach about %d%% of the commanded angle, where roughly 100%% is expected; this figure is fitted from %d steering samples. Subsequent turn commands are now rescaled by this ratio automatically and stay corrected for the rest of this session, so no change to in-game camera sensitivity or mouse DPI is needed; if you change those settings later, restart the app so the ratio is measured again. This notice does not stop the task.
zipline.import_sign_in_hint: In the browser window that just opened, click "Sign in" at the top-right of the map page, then sign in with the in-game account whose ziplines you want to import or update.
zipline.import_login_ok: Signed in successfully. Importing / updating ziplines…
zipline.import_timeout: Zipline import timed out
zipline.account_unknown: Ziplines were not used: the current in-game UID was not captured during initialization, so the matching account data cannot be selected safely. This route will walk throughout and will not try another account's data. This notice does not interrupt the task.
zipline.import_done: UID %d: Zipline coordinates updated: %d entries. Saved for %d account(s) in total.
zipline.legacy_claimed: Zipline coordinates imported by an older version were kept: %d map(s) of coordinates are now attributed to the current account. They take part in navigation without being imported again. This attribution only happens while the current account still has no zipline records of its own; records already imported under this account are never replaced by the legacy ones. Run "🚡 Import / Update Zipline Coordinates" to refresh them. This notice does not interrupt the task.
zipline.no_data: Ziplines were not used on this route. To enable them, run the "🚡 Import / Update Zipline Coordinates" task separately first.
zipline.not_chosen: Ziplines were not used on this route: none of the ziplines in the current area passed the benefit check. Typical reasons are that reaching the mount point costs more than walking directly, the mount point lies outside the game's NPC-walkable area, or the landing point is too far from the destination. This notice does not interrupt the task.
